qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants
rationale: All members concern activation of FGFR1-4 receptors; unlike the confusables, which centre on FGFR1/2 downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades, this theme holds the b/c isoform ligand-binding events, FGFR2 splicing and oncogenic point mutants (plus FGFR3 signalling).

core: Mitochondrial depolarization and outer membrane permeabilization
name: Mitochondrial depolarization and permeabilization in apoptosis
rationale: Most members concern loss of mitochondrial membrane potential and MOMP-driven apoptosis (viral Vpr and influenza, osmotic stress), with nucleotide-biosynthesis regulation terms likely sharing the same ANT/VDAC machinery; the confusables instead cover nucleotide interconversion and adenine nucleotide/NAD transport without apoptosis.

qualifier: MTF1-metallothionein; zinc, copper and other heavy metals
name: MTF1-metallothionein response to zinc, copper and heavy metals
rationale: Members are responses to zinc, copper, manganese, iron, cobalt, lead, mercury and selenium plus MTF1 and metallothionein metal binding; this separates the theme from cadmium-specific detoxification and ROS/HMOX1 confusables.

name: Circadian clock machinery and its control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members cover the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER clock loop with its metabolic outputs (gluconeogenesis, PGC-1alpha, PPARA, beta-cell, thermogenesis); confusables share only the metabolic nuclear-receptor terms and lack the clock itself, focusing on LXR/SREBP lipids, adipogenesis or glucocorticoids.

name: Retinoic acid synthesis and CYP26-mediated degradation
rationale: Members concern retinoic acid biosynthesis, metabolism, vitamin A response and CYP26B1/C1 defects; this distinguishes the theme from vitamin D metabolism and from retinol/retinal metabolism and the visual cycle.

name: AKT-mediated regulation of FOXO transcription factors
rationale: All members describe AKT phosphorylation, localization, acetylation and transcriptional output of FOXO factors, absent from the p53/mTOR, PPAR, NRF2 and glucagon confusables.

core: Sulfate and selenate activation via PAPS synthase
name: PAPS sulfate activation and selenocysteine synthesis
rationale: Members cover PAPS/PAP metabolism and PAPSS2 defects alongside selenate reduction, selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough, which share sulfurylase-type activation; the selenium/selenocysteine arm separates it from sulfonation, thyroid and nucleotide-sugar transport confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor and neuropeptide signaling in behavior
rationale: Members combine dopamine and neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signaling with behaviours they govern (drug reward, sleep, mating, aggression, stress); confusables cover feeding/HPA endocrine control, catecholamine synthesis and transport, or nicotinic receptors instead.

name: MET/HGF receptor and PTK6 kinase signaling
rationale: Members are MET activation and effectors (including InlB entry, MST1 and receptor recycling) and PTK6 signaling; the confusables are ERBB/EGFR, ALK/LTK and EGFR downregulation themes lacking MET and PTK6.

qualifier: lineage commitment and terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid commitment and terminal red cell differentiation
rationale: Members are erythrocyte differentiation terms and blood modules for erythroid-megakaryocytic commitment and late erythroid membrane remodeling; confusables instead emphasise heme/oxygen transport, megakaryocyte development or primitive/definitive erythropoiesis.

qualifier: membrane cargo targeting into the cilium
name: Targeting of membrane cargo into the cilium
rationale: Most members describe sorting of receptors and lipidated proteins into cilia (BBSome, VxPx, myristoylated, ARL13B-INPP5E), distinguishing the theme from intraflagellar transport, cilium assembly/disassembly and photoreceptor confusables.

name: KATP channel sulfonylurea receptor subunits and their disorders
rationale: All members concern KATP channels and defects in their ABCC8/ABCC9 subunits, separating the theme from other potassium channel families, ischemia responses and insulin-secretion confusables.

qualifier: cohesion, condensation and centromeric chromatin assembly
name: Chromosome cohesion, condensation and centromeric chromatin assembly
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading and resolution, chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition; confusables instead emphasise spindle/cytokinesis/nuclear envelope, meiotic recombination or histone acetylation.

name: Deubiquitinases, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover deubiquitinase families and chain-specific deubiquitination, neddylation/COP9 and proteasome assembly, which the confusables (E3 ligation and chain-type ubiquitination, NF-kappaB regulation) lack.

name: BDNF-TrkB and RAC1-driven postsynaptic actin plasticity
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2 signaling and NMDAR-RAC1 activation to postsynaptic actin remodeling and structural plasticity, distinct from dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis and AMPA receptor trafficking confusables.

name: Stress-driven striated muscle adaptation and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members concern adaptive remodeling of cardiac and skeletal muscle (stress hypertrophy, cardiac adaptation, fast-slow fiber transition, myocyte apoptosis), unlike confusables on cardiomyocyte growth, contraction, regeneration or atrophy.

name: Epithelial adherens junctions and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover adherens junction assembly and maintenance, calcium-dependent epithelial adhesion and apical-basal polarity, whereas confusables emphasise EMT, desmosomes or CDH1 processing.

core: Negative regulation of T cell activation
name: Suppression of effector T cell proliferation and Th1 cytokines
rationale: All members restrain T cell activation, proliferation and IL-2/IFN-gamma/Th1 output, distinct from confusables on Treg differentiation, other cytokine suppression and tolerance induction.

name: Planar cell polarity signaling driving convergent extension
rationale: Members cover PCP/non-canonical Wnt regulation and convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate, distinct from axial mesoderm, neural plate patterning and left-right asymmetry confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor control of oxidative metabolism
name: PGC-1alpha-PPARalpha oxidative metabolism and ROR/REV-ERB clock transcription
rationale: Members are PGC-1alpha activation, mitochondrial biogenesis, PPARA and fatty acid response together with ROR/REV-ERB control of BMAL1/CLOCK expression; confusables are ChREBP glucose sensing, PPARG adipogenesis and LXR/SREBP lipid regulation.

name: cAMP-dependent PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation
rationale: Members cover PKA activation, forskolin response and adenylate cyclase-driven CREB activation; confusables focus on cAMP synthesis/degradation or CaMK-driven CREB phosphorylation.

name: Visual retinoid cycle and its inherited retinal defects
rationale: Members are the rod and cone retinoid cycles, A2E formation and LRAT/RDH/ABCA4/STRA6 defects, distinct from general retinol metabolism and opsin phototransduction confusables.

qualifier: antitumor T cell regulation and PD-L1
name: Liver regeneration, hepatocyte survival and antitumor T cell regulation
rationale: Members pair hepatocyte proliferation, differentiation and protection from death-receptor/TNF apoptosis with regulation of T cell immunity to tumors (PD-L1 degradation, STAT3); confusables are pro-apoptotic death-receptor or PD-L1-processing themes without the liver arm.

qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerves
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover morphogenesis of eye, optic nerve, cochlea, semicircular canals, cranial ganglia and taste papillae; confusables are limited to retinal cell differentiation, inner-ear cell fate or olfactory/facial structures.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water, glycerol and urea transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water, glycerol and urea transport
rationale: Members cover vasopressin signaling, aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport, whereas confusables emphasise sodium/chloride transport, osmotic stress and renin-angiotensin control.
